payload.claim: saffron/ledger.py is itself one of the paths listed in .saffron/policy.yaml's elevate_on list, so this spec's build runs with effective_risk computed as "elevated" regardless of the frontmatter's unstated (default "standard") risk, which makes the size gate blocking rather than advisory per saffron/gates/core/size.py's own docstring. This is not a defect since the spec's own measured 757 changed tokens sits well under the bug ceiling of 1300 either way, but the operator should know the size check is not merely advisory here, purely because saffron/ledger.py is touched, not anything the spec declared.
